## Context / Problem
Eleven lifecycle-interface files contain 32 audited prose blocks. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`; symbol and neighboring-code anchors replace shifted line ranges.

## Approach
Condense only anchored comments and true leading docstrings in Scope. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, constants, fixture values, decorators, assertion text, and executable statements.

Parse immutable before/final blobs with `type_comments=True`; remove only leading docstrings from modules, classes, functions, and async functions; normalize `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining ASTs to match. Restrict comment edits to anchored blocks and adjacent blank lines. Compare directives and shebangs byte-for-byte.

## Scope
- `test_caused_by_autoderive_heldout.py` module docstring — retain library/documentation coverage and exact pointers to canonical single-culprit and ambiguous-blame nodes.
- `test_caused_by_autoderive.py` module docstring — retain explicit/automatic derivation and the companion-file boundary.
- `test_claim_transition_parent_cascade.py` docstrings for closed-parent reactivation and table-edge cascade — retain public-surface coverage.
- `test_close_does_not_compact_barbet.py` module and `test_close_never_holds_the_lock_across_a_fold` docstrings — retain never-compact-on-close, explicit compaction, and the forbidden-state oracle.
- `test_close_symbolic_ref_pins_3e21.py` module docstring — retain single symbolic-ref resolution shared by verification/signing and the concurrent-ref hazard.
- `test_exit_codes.py` module and exhaustive route/document test docstrings — retain canonical membership and the asymmetric set invariant.
- `test_force_unification_blusterous.py` module docstring — retain canonical force spellings, audit reasons, close-reason separation, and loud rejection of removed inputs.
- `test_plan_review_dependency_invalidation_790c.py` module and own-material cancellation test docstrings — retain own/dependency invalidation, unrelated-write tolerance, cancellation timing, and recovery guidance.
- `test_plan_review_gate.py` module; blocks anchored to `_TP_SYMBOL`, `_GroundingVerifierFake._verification`, `_capture_review_plan_kwargs`, local-source refusal assertions, null-`verified_at_sha` loop, and sign-review recovery; plus the named docstrings at those anchors — retain claim certification, third-party grounding with absent-symbol control, sign-on-PASS boundaries, and local-source non-certifiability.
- `test_ref_coherence.py` module; `_sign` legacy-attestation block; degraded-basis block; and the two named unresolved-ref docstrings — retain reviewed/current basis, legacy no-pin behavior, and fail-closed degradation without breaking legacy verification.
- `test_transition_reason_honest_3803.py` module docstring — retain reason-required close classes, refusal elsewhere, force-text separation, and neutral transition probing.

Consumers are pytest, lifecycle/claim/close gates, `docs/exit-codes.md`, caused-by companion coverage, plan-review status/signing coverage, and `check_comment_hygiene.py`. No runtime docstring reader was found.

Preserve eight `# type: ignore[no-untyped-def]` directives in `test_claim_transition_parent_cascade.py`, the attr-defined directive in `test_exit_codes.py`, two override directives in `test_plan_review_dependency_invalidation_790c.py`, and three override directives in `test_plan_review_gate.py`, all byte-exact and attached.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only scoped comments, true leading docstrings, or adjacent blank lines change; normalized AST equality passes.
- [ ] Runtime values, assertions, decorators, and executable statements remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every directive remains byte-identical and attached to the same statement.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and removes repetition, history, ornament, or obvious narration.
- [ ] A non-author reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per edited block with immutable before/final citations, preserved contract/consumer, before/after words, and both verdicts.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `semantic-preservation=PASS` and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing or failing rows block closure.
- [ ] The normalized guard, focused tests, comment-hygiene check, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass.

## Verification
Run the recorded normalized-AST/allowlist/directive comparator; the eleven impacted lifecycle files; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; path-scoped `git diff --check`; and `make verify`. The independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality.
